And *Bracton* saith, *Finis est extremitas uniuscujusque rei, hoc est, idem in quo unaquaeque res terminatur, & ideo dicitur finalis concordia, quia imponit finem Litibus*. For as the Common Law hath prescribed a sure and safe way to require and get the Property of Goods, by sale in Market Overt; so also the Common Law hath ordained a sure manner of Conveyance for the Purchaser of Lands; which, as our Statute saith, was by *Fine*.
